questions.question: What is the fastest land animal?
questions.hint: The cheetah can reach speeds of up to 100–120 km/h in short bursts.

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb from the atmosphere during photosynthesis?
questions.hint: Plants use carbon dioxide and sunlight to produce food and release oxygen.

questions.question: Who is the creator of the Marvel Cinematic Universe concept?
questions.hint: Kevin Feige is the president of Marvel Studios and the main architect behind the MCU.

questions.question: In which movie series does the character 'Frodo Baggins' appear?
questions.hint: Frodo Baggins is the main ring-bearer in The Lord of the Rings trilogy.

questions.question: What does a yellow traffic light usually indicate?
options: Prepare to stop or proceed with caution
questions.hint: Yellow signals warn drivers that the light is about to change to red.

questions.question: Which organization issues passports in most countries?
questions.hint: Passports are issued by official government agencies responsible for citizenship and travel documents.

questions.question: The Great Wall of China was primarily built to protect against which group?
questions.hint: The wall was built to defend Chinese states from invasions, especially from Mongol tribes.

questions.question: Which empire was ruled by Julius Caesar?
questions.hint: Julius Caesar played a key role in the transformation of the Roman Republic.

questions.question: In cricket, how many runs are scored when the ball crosses the boundary without touching the ground?
questions.hint: A ball hit over the boundary on the full scores six runs.

questions.question: Which country won the FIFA World Cup in 2018?
questions.hint: France defeated Croatia in the 2018 World Cup final.

questions.question: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.hint: The Sahara is the largest hot desert on Earth.

questions.question: Which river is the longest in the world?
questions.hint: The Nile River is traditionally considered the longest river in the world.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.hint: Gold’s symbol comes from its Latin name 'Aurum'.

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.hint: An adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones.

questions.question: Which country is known for the tradition of Oktoberfest?
questions.hint: Oktoberfest is a world-famous festival held in Munich, Germany.

questions.question: Which musical instrument has black and white keys?
questions.hint: The piano uses keys to produce different musical notes.

questions.question: What is the main source of energy for Earth's climate system?
questions.hint: The Sun provides heat and energy that drives weather and climate.

questions.question: Which continent has the most countries?
questions.hint: Africa has the highest number of countries of any continent.

questions.question: What is the center of an atom called?
questions.hint: The nucleus contains protons and neutrons at the center of an atom.

questions.question: Which animated movie features the character Simba?
questions.hint: Simba is the main character in Disney's The Lion King.
